en.content: The number of 4-digit numbers which are neither multiple of 7 nor multiple of 3 is ____________.
en.explanation:
A = 4-digit numbers divisible by 3

A = 1002, 1005, ....., 9999.

9999 = 1002 + (n 1)3

(n 1)3 = 8997 n = 3000

B = 4-digit numbers divisible by 7

B = 1001, 1008, ......., 9996

9996 = 1001 + (n 1)7

n = 1286

A B = 1008, 1029, ....., 9996

9996 = 1008 + (n 1)21

n = 429

So, no divisible by either 3 or 7

= 3000 + 1286 429 = 3857

total 4-digits numbers = 9000

required numbers = 9000 3857 = 5143
